params.prompt: Edit this photo: replace ONLY the two moons, and keep everything else exactly as it is: the same roof, ledge, city skyline, clouds, sky colours, camera and light. These are the two moons of an alien planet, NOT Earth's moon, and they must look completely different from each other. The moon in the upper left: a very large rust-orange and amber world with swirling banded storm stripes, like a small gas giant, with a soft warm glow. The moon in the upper right: much smaller, a pale lavender-white icy moon with long dark fracture lines and a thin crescent of shadow across one side. Different size, different colour, different surface. No Earth moon craters on either. Neither moon is green or cyan. No people, no text, no logos.
